name: Blockyard Neoforge
author: operator@blockyard.local
description: Reviewed Minecraft 1.21.1 installer. EULA acceptance is required separately. Loader variables are operator-managed.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
rm -f .blockyard-install.json
[[ "1.${NEOFORGE_VERSION%.*}" == "$MC_VERSION" ]] || { echo 'NeoForge release does not match Minecraft'; exit 1; }
curl --user-agent "Blockyard/0.1 (Minecraft hosting)" --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 600 --fail --location --retry 3 "https://maven.neoforged.net/releases/net/neoforged/neoforge/${NEOFORGE_VERSION}/neoforge-${NEOFORGE_VERSION}-installer.jar" -o installer.jar
# Verify Mojang's release artifact before invoking installers with short network timeouts.
vanilla="libraries/net/minecraft/server/${MC_VERSION}/server-${MC_VERSION}.jar"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$vanilla")"
if [[ ! -f "$vanilla" ]] || ! printf '%s  %s\n' "$MOJANG_SERVER_SHA1" "$vanilla" | sha1sum --check --status; then
 curl --user-agent "Blockyard/0.1 (Minecraft hosting)" --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 600 --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --fail --location "https://piston-data.mojang.com/v1/objects/${MOJANG_SERVER_SHA1}/server.jar" -o "$vanilla.part"
 printf '%s  %s\n' "$MOJANG_SERVER_SHA1" "$vanilla.part" | sha1sum --check -
 mv "$vanilla.part" "$vanilla"
fi
installed=false
for attempt in 1 2 3; do
 if java -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75.0 -jar installer.jar --installServer; then installed=true; break; fi
 sleep 5
done
[[ "$installed" == true ]] || exit 1
cp "libraries/net/neoforged/neoforge/${NEOFORGE_VERSION}/unix_args.txt" unix_args.txt
rm installer.jar
printf '{"software":"NEOFORGE","minecraft_version":"%s","loader_version":"%s"}\n' "${MC_VERSION}" "${NEOFORGE_VERSION}" > .blockyard-install.json.tmp
mv .blockyard-install.json.tmp .blockyard-install.json
